prod_iphone16_128gb.summary: Most customers praise the smooth A18 performance, camera control key, and exceptional battery life. Minor complaints mention minimal design changes from iPhone 15 and packaging simplicity.
neutrals: Camera control takes 1-2 days of practice

sample_reviews.author: Rahul S.
sample_reviews.text: Upgraded from iPhone 12. Battery life easily lasts 1.5 days! The camera control button is super helpful for quick snapshots.

sample_reviews.author: Priya M.
sample_reviews.text: Great phone overall. Fast delivery on Amazon. Only downside is 60Hz display at this price tag.

sample_reviews.author: Vikram K.
sample_reviews.text: Decent upgrade if coming from iPhone 13 or older, but very similar to iPhone 15.

prod_samsung_s25.summary: Users love the titanium feel, blazing Snapdragon 8 Gen 4 speed, and Galaxy AI live translate features. Some users note the phone runs warm during heavy gaming.
negatives: Warms up slightly under high gaming load
neutrals: One UI 7 layout has a slight learning curve

sample_reviews.author: Amit Sharma
sample_reviews.text: The Galaxy AI tools are brilliant! Screen is remarkably bright even under direct outdoor sunlight.

prod_sony_xm5.summary: Unrivaled active noise cancellation and supreme comfort for long travel sessions. A few users missed the folding hinge mechanism from the previous XM4 model.
negatives: Does not fold into compact pouch

sample_reviews.author: Kavita R.
sample_reviews.text: Perfect for flight travel! Silences engine noise completely. Worth every rupee.

prod_hp_pavilion15.summary: Excellent productivity laptop with fast 13th Gen Core i7 CPU and B&O speakers. Battery life is moderate (5-6 hours under heavy browsing).

prod_samsung_tv55.summary: Incredible 4K clarity, vibrant colors, and smooth smart TV interface. Sound quality is standard, recommending a soundbar for movie lovers.
